args: Step 1: Use search_web to scout active cultural trends regarding financial wellness, intentional living, and money psychology. Step 2: Draft a premium, authentic 3-sentence thought leadership tip inspired by the discovered trend (pure organic tone, zero sales pitches or studio promotion). Step 3: Use generate_image to synthesize a beautiful minimalist aesthetic photograph reflecting today's theme (e.g. a serene morning table ritual or abstract iridescent droplet). Save the generated image to public/anyen_dynamic_daily.jpg. Step 4: Execute 'npx tsx scripts/publish_social.ts' with the drafted caption and https://an-yen.com/anyen_dynamic_daily.jpg.
description: Dynamic web-scouting and image-synthesizing publishing workflow.
